question.prompt: The taxi fare in Gotham City is \(\$2.40\) for the first \(\dfrac{1}{2}\) mile and additional mileage charged at the rate \(\$0.20\) for each additional \(0.1\) mile. You plan to give the driver a \(\$2\) tip. How many miles can you ride for \(\$10\)?

solutions.explanation:
First set aside the \(\$2\) tip and the \(\$2.40\) fare covering the first \(0.5\) mile. This leaves
\[
\$10-\$2-\$2.40=\$5.60
\]
for additional mileage. Each additional \(0.1\) mile costs \(\$0.20\), so the remaining money buys \(5.60\div0.20=28\) such portions.

The greatest distance is therefore
\[
0.5+28(0.1)=3.3\text{ miles},
\]
choice \(\text{C}\).
solutions.title: Find the budget for additional mileage
